entities.summary: Charles Angélique François Huchet, Comte de la Bédoyère was a French general during the reign of Emperor Napoleon I. He was executed in 1815 by the restored Bourbon monarchy, having been an aide-de-camp to Napoleon throughout the Hundred Days before the Battle of Waterloo.

entities.summary: Charles Angélique François Huchet, Comte de la Bédoyère was a French general during the reign of Emperor Napoleon I. He was executed in 1815 by the restored Bourbon monarchy, having been an aide-de-camp to Napoleon throughout the Hundred Days before the Battle of Waterloo.
